svg.title: PC-12 CONTROL YOKE - SECTIONS
svg.desc: PC12-L6Y2 rev G, AS SHOWN, A1. RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.

PHOTO CHECK (rev M): THE DRAWN SOLIDS RAY-CAST THROUGH THE PHOTO CAMERAS (mm, + = drawn wider)
GRIP SIDES PER BAND OF h: SIGNED MAX mm (h -50..-30 | -30..-10 | -10..10 | 10..30)

GRIP PLANES (rev L, judges FID3-01): rake / toe / a0 / walls / depth fitted per grip to the curated rows and pad traces of 6 views -- P1046408 L / R, P1046410, Mexico L / R and P1046409 (posed this round: a two-view camera

with panel_408, 25° from inboard) -- with the front outline held: outboard 20.4° / 6.9° / -4.4 / 0.64, depth 30 / 27 / 22 at h -47 / 0 / 45; inboard 21.3° / 16.7° / -6.1 / 0.04 (its depth above h 0 unconstrained: no view sees the inboard

forward face). Table: 20 / 18 / -3.75, -6.0 / 0.6, 0 / 27.5 at the bottom, 27 above. Outboard cost +7 % at rake -2.5°, +8 % at a0 +/-5, +10 % at a bottom depth +/-4; the TOE is weak (7..22 within +7 %, inboard 0..26 within the noise;

open point 2 of L6Y). The AOPA views are CHECK ONLY (one radial term; the co-pilot outer -11 / -22, slot -12 / -15, pad 9.5): not fitted, not tabled. Rev M (judges FID4-05): that co-pilot camera is EXTRAPOLATED from the
pilot-yoke solution -- not a degenerate pose; its re-calibration on the panel round the co-pilot yoke is open, the toe / depth law / head depths stay [M weak].

INBOARD NECK (criterion, P1046408): the drawn moulding's top edge vs the strongest photo edge per pixel column, arm tip to head -- pilot mean -1.3, |mean| 2.3, max -7.4 mm (against the red placard; the max where the edge

turns vertical under the head, ill-posed per column); co-pilot -4.6, max -7.5: there the search locks onto the PFD's text rows above the neck (overlay inspected: the drawn edge lies on the photo's neck, dark on dark). Rev L raised

Pose per photo fitted to the COVER landmarks only (TCS, AFCS, badge, step ends, lower-insert corners, foot; P1046409 with its own picks); heads, grips, pads, neck and shell are checks. Grip rows: the CURATED photo

silhouettes -- auto edges per image row in the near views with the panel recesses masked, the inboard slot sides hand-traced and snapped past the J band / panel seam, P1046409 traced at 4x; slot rows above h 24 (the arm's

underside, not the grip) not scored -- against the ray-cast grip's own hits (part-labelled), per image row, h on the grip axis. The band maxima below h -37 are the rows that cut the grips' rounded bottom ends (1 mm of height reads

3-10 mm of width there); above it the row medians are 0.5-0.7 (outboard slot), 0.3-2.6 (outer sides), 0.4-3.5 (inboard slot), 90 % of the rows within 1-6.6. Overlays: refs/cache/overlays/yoke (private).
CORNERS & RADII (every other sample is on a C2 spline); NO OTHER EDGE IS SHARP
NO CORNERS: one C2 run joined to the other half at u 0 (rev M, judges DR4-07); its first 12 samples are the top edge (body_top)
NO CORNERS: one C2 run joined to the other half at u 0 (rev M, judges DR4-07); its first 11 samples are the top edge (body_top)
perimeter R 1; arm lower R 2; foot underside R 3; tip facet corners R 2
frame roll R 1.5; forward R 11 [E] capped at 0.45 x the inscribed half-width; heel R 4; trim face R 1.5; pad step crisp, groove 1 x 0.5, bead 0.4
rounds in order: sides x aft face R 2, x top plane R 2, x forward face R 8 [E] easing to R 5 under the foot, R 3 behind the arms / necks [E]; under the foot the side draft's offset
capped at 4 [E]; AFCS boss aft edge R 0.8, back edge R 0.8, blend R 1.5
body + grips joined by a ROLLING-BALL round R 3 (none where their faces run flush); then each pad's pocket, groove and bead (pad_finish); the web's aft face on the trim
face's plane 3.5 below it, joined to the grip plane over 8; the low neck's aft face onto the shield facet's plane 0.5 below it over |u| 76-90; body top line a C2 cubic
aft side: prism trimmed 3 inside the head above h 67 / 61, drafted 3 / 1 per mm below from a bend of R 4, cut R 1.5; head chamfer R 3, floor R 3 at h 62 / 50; head-to-prism R
3; then walls (aft edge R 1.5 -> 2) and forward face (R 11 capped -> 3; over the head's top onto it R 3); shield facet edge R 1.5, its directrix tangent at the widest points (no
crown soft break R 20; top land C1 chamfer 2 x 0.8; TCS seat 1.5 deep

CURVE LAW (rev M text, judges DR4-03): each outline split at its corner samples into runs, each run a C2 cubic spline on centripetal knots ('natural' ends at corners, periodic for a closed outline without corners), 0.05

sampling (arcs too); corners R 0 sharp, R > 0 a tangent fillet (cubic Bezier arc; tangent length R tan(th/2) capped at 0.45 of the shorter run -- none capped); YOKE_DESIGN curve_law; the solids use the EXACT distance to
these polylines (beyond 0.3 mm a C2 B-spline of exact node distances, blended C2).

ACCEPTANCE (model/yoke_checks.py, judges DR2-01..04, DR4-01 / 02): fields: zero level vs the curve-law polylines, max shell 0.0059, grip_out 0.0045, grip_in 0.0079, pad_out 0.0045, pad_in 0.0045, body 0.0052 mm;

curve law (C2): max relative curvature jump at the interior samples 8.3e-07 over 301 samples of 10 outlines; nothing above the trim face: max 0.00 mm; above the shield facet: max 0.00 mm; untabled cusps (contour turning

> 25 deg within +-0.15 mm AND the surface normals turning as much): grip_out 0 / 54 sections, grip_in 0 / 54 sections, necks / web / heads (u planes) 0 / 19 sections, horizontal (h planes) 0 / 16 sections, Z-Z 0, K-K 0 (52

contour tips set aside: planes grazing a tabled round, the normals turning less); black moulding one piece per side in every horizontal section h 62..94 (step 2; none above a head's top): yes; CREASES (rev M, judges

DR4-02; adaptive scan of 14 views incl. sides / below: every pixel pair turning > 4 deg refined 2 x 16x, a crease when the turn stays in one sub-step): untabled 0; 2218 tabled crease pixels set aside, 86562 candidate pairs

resolved as rounds; joins read smooth fields at the rounds' own surface points (a ridge = a unit gradient turning > 20 deg within 0.01 mm; min |grad| in brackets): body x outboard grip (R 3) 6 / 6934 points (|grad| >= 0.59),

body x inboard grip (R 3) 0 / 3023 points (|grad| >= 0.70), outboard prism aft side x head (R 3) 1 / 2593 points (|grad| >= 0.56), inboard prism aft side x head (R 3) 0 / 1510 points (|grad| >= 0.94); pads EXPOSED as drawn

(judges DR4-01; the moulding ray-cast from aft vs the drawn leather / groove / bead heights inside each pad outline): out 0.0 mm2 off by > 0.05 (max 0.00), buried 0.0 mm2, in 0.0 mm2 off by > 0.05 (max 0.00), buried 0.0

mm2; fillets reduced by the 0.45-of-run cap (judges DR4-03): none; vertex normals vs analytic (depth-map meshes 0.25 mm from aft, 0.4 from above-aft / the front; 95th / 99th / max deg; tabled creases, the cover's 0.8 mm

top land and part boundaries apart): cover stem / inserts 0.00 / 0.06 / 0.7 (creases 21); cover arm + TCS 0.15 / 0.79 / 4.3 (creases 8); outboard grip pad / frame 0.36 / 1.19 / 29.4 (creases 2); inboard grip pad / frame 0.31 /

1.54 / 4.2 (creases 30); outboard head + face 0.73 / 1.92 / 5.4 (creases 73); inboard head + shield 0.65 / 1.57 / 5.3 (creases 4); web (aft) 0.46 / 1.83 / 30.3 (creases 6); body top + web top (from above-aft) 0.01 / 0.85 / 12.0

SECTIONS: exact contours of the solids (model/yoke_geom.py) on the cutting planes; the black body and the grips are one moulding (a rolling-ball round R 3), the white cover a separate part, the leather pad hatched apart
(its 3.0 layer [E]); where a section is clipped to its window the cut edge is a thin phantom break line.
Sources per value: the [M] / [E] / [S] tags of YOKE_DESIGN (printed in model/interior.py).
first issue with L6Y rev B (judges r1): exact sections of the rev J solids, grip profiles with the heel lip, trim face / shield, switch profiles, column surround, corner table, photo check

rev K (judges r2): exact-field solids; Z-Z / K-K with ordinates; cusp-free grip sections; pad groove + bead, heel lip R 4; D / E / G exact switch cuts; J-J; acceptance; photo check on curated silhouettes, grip planes fitted to 7 views

rev L (judges r3): K-K through TCS / AFCS; grip sections cut the moulding; dimensions off the solids; head-zone surfaces and rounds tabled; acceptance on heads / necks / web / tops / forward faces + one-piece and C2 rows;
photo check on 6 views; detail J U recess

rev M (judges r4): pads exposed as drawn (pocket cut after the join); rolling-ball R 3 joins; head zones share walls / forward face; leather hatched apart; detail S, break lines, detail W [E] switches; adaptive crease / ridge / pad
acceptance, all clean (head top R 3 onto the forward face, body sides x top rolling ball, C2 forward-radius cap, tangent inboard directrix, 0.05 sampling, C2 fields); photo check re-run

rev N (3-D judges r1): F rocker slot 2.5 deep (draft 7 deg), letter-block legends in the pilot's reading order; G MAP LIGHTS blocks, satin-nickel collar; H raised blank plate; J recess to h 27, band 22 wide; OWNER DECISIONS
2026-10-11: J band + recess re-centred on the column axis (hub WL 1845; photos 1821), push 65 (was 90 [E])

rev O (3-D judges r2): G push button = gloss-black legend disc 17.5 + nickel hex 12 A/C + cap 10.2, MAP LIGHTS on the disc; F rocker ends 9.5, crowned 0.6; H one outline groove, plate 0.2; legends 0.35 of the pitch

rev P (3-D judges r3): F satin charcoal lunes, near-black matte slot; legends 0.22 of the pitch, uneven; J the band's hook ends round (tip at 330 deg), the viewer's parked rest 35 forward (YOKE rest), column matte near-black
